extracted.intended_audience: general readers, fans of Peanuts, and researchers interested in comic-strip history and media adaptations
extracted.subtask_description: A descriptive encyclopedia-style account of the Peanuts comic strip and its franchise, covering adaptations (TV, film, music, theater), licensing, merchandising, park appearances, ownership changes, and exhibitions. Intended to record factual history and cultural impact rather than provide prescriptive guidance.
